# Spark Brake & Parts Cleaner

> Spark is a professional-strength, non-chlorinated, low VOC brake and parts cleaner sold in a 550 ml aerosol can. It removes brake fluid, grease, oil and dirt, dries fast and leaves no residue. It is supplied from 5925 Tomken Rd, Unit 11, Mississauga, ON L4W 4L8, Canada, to workshops, fleets and distributors.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sparkbrakeclean.com/): product overview, how to use, applications, specifications, safety and FAQ
- [Brake cleaner guide](https://sparkbrakeclean.com/brake-cleaner-guide): how to clean brakes step by step, chlorinated vs non-chlorinated brake cleaner, safe surfaces, safety rules
- [About](https://sparkbrakeclean.com/about): who Spark is for and what the brand stands for
- [Contact](https://sparkbrakeclean.com/contact): enquiry form, address and map

## Key facts

- Product: brake & parts cleaner, aerosol, 550 ml
- Formulation: non-chlorinated, low VOC
- Residue: none; no wiping needed
- Compatibility: metals and most surfaces (test plastics, rubber and paint first)
- Uses: brake systems, clutch components, cars and light vehicles, trucks and fleets, machinery and tools
- Grade: professional and DIY
- Safety: extremely flammable; use in a well-ventilated area; keep away from heat, sparks and flame; store below 50 °C
- Supply: distributor terms and bulk supply available by enquiry
